description: A deployment script for installing prplMesh IPK packages on remote devices via SSH, with options for certification mode and SSH proxy configuration.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the script.

methods.name: deploy
methods.description: Handles the deployment process: copying IPK, removing old packages, installing new package, and enabling certification mode if specified.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Parses command-line options and initiates deployment.
